en_title: Sony and Nintendo Should Keep the Current Gen Going for as Long as Possible 'Because People Are Very Happy Using PS5 and Switch 2,' Former PlayStation Exec Says
cn_title: 吉田修平：索尼任天堂应延续本世代
subtitle: 下一代还不急
opus_summary: 前PlayStation全球工作室负责人吉田修平表示，索尼和任天堂应尽可能延长PS5与Switch 2的生命周期。随着内存等零部件成本上涨，加之玩家和开发者暂无迫切升级需求，两家公司或将推迟下一代主机。

paragraphs.en: Sony and Nintendo need to make their current consoles last as long as possible amid soaring costs that have already prompted PS5 and Switch 2 price rises.
paragraphs.cn: 面对不断飙升的成本，以及已经导致PS5和Switch 2涨价的现实，索尼和任天堂需要尽可能延长现有主机的生命周期。

paragraphs.en: That's according to former PlayStation Worldwide Studios boss Shuhei Yoshida, who told The Verge that console companies needed to focus on sustaining their current hardware platforms for "as long as possible."
paragraphs.cn: 前PlayStation全球工作室负责人吉田修平向The Verge表示，主机厂商应专注于让当前硬件平台「尽可能长时间」地持续运营。

paragraphs.en: While there's no suggestion that Nintendo plans to launch a Switch 3 anytime soon (Switch 2 only arrived last year!), the company always devotes a chunk of its budget to researching future hardware. And upgrades to the launch Switch 2 model will undoubtedly be considered at some point, similar to the Switch Lite and Switch OLED.
paragraphs.cn: 目前没有迹象表明任天堂计划在近期推出Switch 3，毕竟Switch 2去年才上市！不过，任天堂一直会将部分预算用于研究未来硬件。今后，该公司无疑也会考虑升级首发版Switch 2，就像推出Switch Lite和Switch OLED一样。

paragraphs.en: As for Sony, we know that a PlayStation 6 is on the way at some point . Previously, analysts had suggested a 2028 launch seemed likely, though Sony is yet to make any official indication of when PS6 may arrive — and as time goes on, that late 2028 release date feels less and less likely . Indeed, Yoshida has suggested that console makers may now be looking to delay the arrival of next-gen hardware as long as possible.
paragraphs.cn: 至于索尼，我们知道PlayStation 6终将在某个时间到来。此前，分析师曾认为该主机可能于2028年推出，但索尼尚未正式透露PS6的发售时间。随着时间推移，2028年末发售的可能性似乎越来越低。吉田修平还表示，主机厂商如今或许正考虑尽可能推迟下一代硬件的到来。

paragraphs.en: "Sony and Nintendo have sold enough numbers of their current-generation hardware, so because of the cost of goods, they might be looking [at] pushing back the launch of next gen," Yoshida said. "I think they should try to keep the current generation as long as possible, because people are very happy using PS5 and Switch 2.
paragraphs.cn: 吉田修平表示：「索尼和任天堂已经卖出了足够多的本世代硬件，因此考虑到商品成本，两家公司可能会考虑推迟下一代主机的发售。我认为，他们应该尽可能延长本世代的生命周期，因为玩家对使用PS5和Switch 2感到非常满意。」

paragraphs.en: "People have [a] finite budget, and it feels like PC and consoles, the components very specific to these devices have increased their price way more than all the other forms of entertainment," he continued. "People who have systems like PS5, Switch 2, or PCs – you know, good enough PCs – probably will be happy to play games on them and not necessarily consider replacing [them]."
paragraphs.cn: 他继续说道：「人们的预算是有限的，而PC和主机这些设备所专用的零部件，价格涨幅似乎远高于其他娱乐形式。拥有PS5、Switch 2或PC的人，也就是那些性能足够好的PC，可能会继续满意地用它们玩游戏，不一定会考虑更换设备。」

paragraphs.en: The key issue here is the skyrocketing cost of computer memory, AKA "RAMageddon", fuelled in part by the rise of AI datacenters. In short, memory production resources are limited, and much of next year's production output is already spoken for. Should Sony, for example, want to start manufacturing a new console anytime soon, it may be physically unable to do so in the volume it would like — let alone being able to sell the console for a price that consumers would pay.
paragraphs.cn: 这里的关键问题在于计算机内存成本暴涨，也就是所谓的「RAMageddon」，而人工智能数据中心的兴起是推高成本的部分原因。简而言之，内存生产资源有限，明年的大部分产能已经被预订。以索尼为例，如果该公司想在近期开始生产新主机，可能根本无法达到理想的产量，更不用说以消费者愿意接受的价格出售了。

paragraphs.en: As a reminder, the Sony launched its PS5 with a disc drive for $500, while its digital-only counterpart sold for $400. These machines now cost $650 and $600 respectively — price rises of $150 and $200 since 2020. PS5 Pro launched at $700, meanwhile, and now costs $900. It's hard to see PS6 arriving at much less than $1,000. Switch 2, meanwhile, has risen in price by $50 since launch last year, from $450 to $500.
paragraphs.cn: 作为参考，索尼推出PS5时，带光驱版本售价为500美元(约合人民币3355元)，纯数字版售价为400美元(约合人民币2684元)。如今，这两款主机的售价分别为650美元(约合人民币4362元)和600美元(约合人民币4026元)，自2020年以来分别上涨了150美元(约合人民币1006元)和200美元(约合人民币1342元)。与此同时，PS5 Pro上市时售价为700美元(约合人民币4697元)，如今已涨至900美元(约合人民币6039元)。很难想象PS6的售价会大幅低于1,000美元(约合人民币6710元)。Switch 2的价格则从去年发售时的450美元(约合人民币3020元)上涨至500美元(约合人民币3355元)，涨幅为50美元(约合人民币336元)。

paragraphs.en: And then there's the general lack of desire from both consumers or developers for machines capable of drastically better performance, something Yoshida also noted. The only exception to this is Xbox, which has been more vocal about its push towards a next-gen offering with Project Helix . The difference with Microsoft's team, though, is it has not sold truckloads of consoles of late.
paragraphs.cn: 此外，消费者和开发者普遍没有表现出对性能大幅提升主机的强烈需求，吉田修平也提到了这一点。唯一的例外是XBOX，该品牌一直更积极地宣传通过Project Helix迈向下一代产品。不过，微软团队与索尼、任天堂的不同之处在于，近来并没有卖出大量主机。

paragraphs.en: "I don't think lots of people are asking for more power — 'We need more power!' — or even developers," Yoshida concluded. "I don't think developers are asking [for] better hardware! So I think that means that the current generation, Sony and Nintendo are going to do pretty well for many years to come, still.
paragraphs.cn: 吉田修平总结道：「我不认为有很多玩家在要求更强的性能，喊着‘我们需要更强的性能！’，开发者也没有这样的要求。我不认为开发者在要求更好的硬件！所以我认为，索尼和任天堂的本世代主机未来许多年仍会表现得相当不错。」

paragraphs.en: "Xbox is a team who wants to change the competing landscape, so it's going to be hard for them, but it's their time to play. It's very exciting, what's going to happen next year?"
paragraphs.cn: 「XBOX团队希望改变竞争格局，因此他们会面临困难，但现在轮到他们登场了。接下来一年会发生什么，令人非常期待。」
